strongest_case: The proposal is substantially stronger than the fixed-source predecessor. It turns an informal memory story into a finite, falsifiable active-stream assay with a common opportunity deck, on-policy actions, authentic/twin/cut/sham mediation clones, assignment-independent compiler randomness, a model-owned compiler bracketed by supplied and mechanical controls, representation-neutral D4 plus A4, acquisition-versus-retention controls, explicit visibility/reset rules, a fixed 26-root confirmation roster, and a deliberately hard four-endpoint intersection-union decision. It also draws unusually honest firewalls: the September deliverable is construction plus DEV rather than confirmation; T09 is only an A4 integrity sentinel; T10 is not applicable to current text claims; LoRA is conditional; P4 cannot by itself attribute gains to the compiler; finite three-checkpoint evidence is not unbounded higher-order learning; and common online caps are not a claim of total-resource equality. Those choices make a credible narrow paper possible if the remaining treatment-defining and gate-defining contradictions are resolved before ratification rather than delegated to an A2 implementation choice.

concerns.statement: REWORK NOW: ORDINARY_SLEEP_CADENCE_V1 is internally inconsistent about whether cadence is independent of realized outcomes. It permits block boundaries and checkpoint choice to use raw-token offsets while forbidding dependence on event meaning or result, but on-policy action/outcome rendering determines the realized event bytes and their token offsets. An A2 table cannot resolve this by mere implementation without choosing a different treatment-defining rule.
concerns.evidence: Systems ambiguity A02 correctly identifies unresolved block construction, cutoffs, and ties, but the problem is stronger than missing tie-breaking. The compiler contract allows monotonically counted raw-token offsets, requires the current snapshot to be the last scheduled snapshot before each tokenizer-exact cutoff, and simultaneously bans cadence dependence on result, model output, failure, or latency. In an active world, the chosen action and returned public event text are results; absent fixed-size preallocated event slots, every subsequent raw-token offset descends from them and can differ by arm. T01 cannot prove a common total opportunity target, T04 cannot isolate compiler cadence, T07 cannot certify blindness, and T12 cannot freeze lawful bytes until the invariant is coherent.

concerns.statement: REWORK NOW: SELF_AGGREGATION_V1 and SELF_LIFECYCLE_READER_V1 do not define a coherent observable state when exact duplicate proposals share a semantic record ID but preserve independent lineages whose Dream2 decisions can diverge. The same semantic payload can thereby be both readable and unavailable, while one-record query selection among multiple readable disagreeing lineages is left open. New Dream2 local additions also lack an unambiguous state-machine entry path.
concerns.evidence: Systems ambiguities A01 and A03 expose the treatment consequences of reducer keys, capacity, lineage, and query order. The contract says exact duplicates share a semantic record ID while retaining source multiplicity; every source slot has an independent lifecycle; incompatible Dream2 decisions remain separate; and the reader exposes only active SELF_RETAINED or SELF_REVISED versions. It does not say whether lifecycle attaches to a lineage-local record instance or the shared semantic record, how a bounded local addition moves from ALLOCATED into a readable state, or which target-independent cursor returns one record when several contrary lineages match. Status, recency, multiplicity, or hidden confidence can therefore silently become a semantic selector. Systems ambiguity A04 adds a second contradiction: the catalog/return policy is said to be identical across methods, even though the same contract requires representation-specific native interfaces and one backend-native record. These are estimand-defining choices, not harmless serialization details.

concerns.statement: REWORK NOW: the sole Monte Carlo power/size gate is not yet an executable prospective decision rule. Its scenario set depends on a later DEV quantity, several scenario families and null configurations are underparameterized, and the disposition of infeasible required scenarios is ambiguous. Because all analytic calculations are explicitly non-gating, this leaves no well-defined confirmation gate.
concerns.evidence: The statistics contract requires the exact simulator and scenario table to be hash-frozen before B0, yet the required grid includes cell failures at the DEV upper bound, which is only observed at B3; no estimator, confidence bound, or pre-DEV functional mapping is defined. 'Skewed beta/binomial', 'zero-inflated marginals', 'antirank coupling', 'others favorable', and 'feasible/admissible scenario' do not identify unique distributions. The one-sided 99% Monte Carlo bound does not name its binomial confidence construction or say whether 99% is per scenario or simultaneous over the full grid. A listed failure scenario that cannot be rescaled to mean 0.20 and SD 0.30 is merely documented, so an adverse case may be excluded rather than stopping confirmation. This directly substantiates systems disagreement D05 and benchmark ambiguity bench_a03: the arithmetic is conditional planning, not established joint power.

concerns.statement: REWORK NOW: the normative claim-test applicability artifact and the proposal do not share a canonical claim namespace. That makes the T09 integrity-only and T10 NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D safeguards vulnerable to being applied to the wrong text claim or silently bypassed.
concerns.evidence: Systems ambiguity A07 is real. change.json uses C_PCFL_* identifiers, while claim_test_applicability.json names C1_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILATION, C2_ACTION_CONDITIONED_RECONSOLIDATION, C3_FINITE_POST_NATIVE_CONTINUAL_ACTION and separate statistics-ladder labels. No machine-readable alias maps those names to the proposal claims, even though the applicability file declares itself normative. T09 and T10 correctly narrow scope in prose, but T11 cannot independently reproduce claim status when the join key is undefined.

concerns.statement: The proposal-level visibility matrix is not the exact Cartesian policy it claims to be: its information rows collapse or omit classes that the bound visibility contract treats separately, including public witness atoms, SELF semantic content and lifecycle-status reasons, prior results, and resource-audit metadata. This creates an authorization gap precisely where the new status and cadence policies add observable metadata.
concerns.evidence: change.json has 13 information rows, whereas visibility_taint_reset_contract.md separately reasons about PUBLIC_WITNESS_ATOM, SELF_SEMANTIC, PRIOR_RESULTS, RESOURCE_AUDIT, and descendant metadata. Authentic prior memory and DEV metrics/resources are not sufficient substitutes for per-slot semantic payload, normalized reader status, privileged audit reason, candidate position, cadence trigger state, and historical-version metadata. A component can therefore comply with the compact proposal matrix while violating the prose closure rule. T07's mutation tests are valuable but are future implementation evidence, not a repair of the ratified information ontology.

concerns.statement: LATER IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE GATE: the exact ordinary action policy and matched-twin outcome transport remain intentionally uninstantiated. That is acceptable only after C01-C02 are repaired and only if A0-A2 remain a genuine pre-model freeze, not a place to tune treatment semantics.
concerns.evidence: Systems ambiguities A05 and A06 are not current empirical failures. The contracts correctly demand frozen backtracking/defer/query/cost behavior and byte-level certification that an authentic recipient and its paired twin differ only in the intended public outcome packet. However, handle validity, charged cost, terminal behavior, after-state compatibility, retry behavior, and cross-world outcome rendering have no artifact yet. These choices affect on-policy exposure and the P1 intervention. T01-T03 and T07 cannot pass on prose alone, and T12 must seal the results before any model call.

concerns.statement: LATER IMPLEMENTATION AND EMPIRICAL GATE: the native readers, generic SELF scaffold, aggregation sizes/overflow encodings, and honest comparator implementations do not yet exist. Their exact construction can erase or manufacture the SELF advantage, so future test passage and DEV behavior must be treated as evidence gates rather than assumed consequences of the specification.
concerns.evidence: Systems ambiguities A01 and A08 can mostly be resolved at A2 after C02 fixes the semantics: literal normalization, capacities, byte sizes, target-independent indexes, prompt scaffolds, operation vocabulary, and join hints still require exact files. Systems disagreement D06 is also decisive: equal calls/bytes/ops do not imply equal total systems effort or SOTA fairness. Benchmark ambiguities bench_a02 and bench_a04 remain live because generic SELF may fail to beat RAG/EXT/MECH and the required golden corpus, native-reader equivalence tests, and independent review do not exist. The design usefully allows RAW, RAG, MECH, and linked explicit-memory methods to succeed; those are honest comparators, not bugs to weaken.

concerns.statement: LATER EMPIRICAL GATE: even after C03 makes the simulator executable, the min-composed P1-P3 endpoints and rootwise-max P4 endpoint can have atoms, skew, and variance unlike the normal planning calculation. Scenario simulation is sensitivity analysis, not proof that the realized root distribution has at least 80% joint power.
concerns.evidence: P1 is the minimum of fifteen root contrasts, P2 and P3 are minima, and P4 subtracts a rootwise maximum. Failure-in-place and discrete binding scores can add mass points. The proposal responsibly supplies an eight-root simultaneous SD-UCB, uniqueness/atom/skew/outlier/Shapiro diagnostics, heavy-tail/skew/zero-inflation simulations, and a hard STOP/calibration-only outcome. Those safeguards address rather than eliminate benchmark ambiguity bench_a03 and systems disagreement D05. The four one-sided tests and intersection-union decision remain legitimate only under the prespecified estimands and independent root unit; no endpoint may be dropped after DEV or confirmation.

concerns.statement: The claim firewall is essential and must survive writing: this is a finite text-first active-stream memory assay, not yet Dream-LoRA-Think, an autonomous learned compiler, unbounded higher-order learning, a SOTA efficiency comparison, or an organism-scale continual-learning result.
concerns.evidence: This resolves rather than rejects systems disagreements D01-D04 and D06 plus benchmark disagreements bench_d01-d03. P1 can localize the randomized memory-to-probe-to-evidence-to-delta-to-action chain; P4 alone cannot attribute benefit to the compiler. A4 checks representation-neutral revision integrity, not revision efficacy. LoRA is correctly NA for current text claims and cannot rescue a failed text cascade. Three post-native checkpoints establish only finite post-native continual action. The organism motivation is broader than C1-C3, and model-owned compilation means frozen model behavior under supplied prompts, not learned autonomous self-improvement.

concerns.statement: LATER OPERATIONS GATE: the 908 target rows per root, mandatory native baselines, clone multiplicity, artifact volume, and 26-root confirmation remain a prospective budget, not demonstrated feasibility. The September milestone cannot be represented as paper confirmation.
concerns.evidence: Benchmark ambiguity bench_a01 is unresolved until B0-B3 produce measured rates; benchmark ambiguity bench_a04 holds because no A0-A2 artifacts or independent review exist. The staged resource manifest, no-pruning rule, all-cells sealing, 520 H100-equivalent-hour/6.5 TB ceiling, and explicit human authorization after September 25 are appropriate protections. They do not guarantee the campaign fits the ceiling. T08 must fail closed on estimate drift. T10 is NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for current text work, and T11 forbids converting construct/DEV output into confirmation evidence or authority.

visibility_failures: Realized public action/outcome bytes can influence raw-token offsets and therefore Dream1/Dream2 timing despite a stated ban on result-dependent cadence.
A shared semantic record ID with divergent lineage lifecycle states can leak multiplicity or status through which payload is returned or marked unavailable.
An unspecified one-record cursor over disagreeing readable lineages can encode recency, confidence, correctness, status, or target-dependent query behavior.
The compact proposal matrix omits explicit lifecycle audit reasons, SELF semantic/status metadata, witness atoms, prior-result metadata, resource audits, and their descendants.
Claim applicability can be misjoined because normative applicability IDs and proposal claim IDs have no canonical alias registry.
missing_acceptance_tests: PAS_MISSING_CADENCE_RESULT_INDEPENDENCE: construct equal presealed opportunity schedules with adversarially different action/outcome text lengths, failures, and event content; prove identical lawful sleep/checkpoint triggers under the chosen ratified accounting rule or reject the bundle.

PAS_MISSING_LIFECYCLE_LINEAGE_COHERENCE: exhaust exact duplicates, disagreeing lineages, divergent Dream2 retain/revise/contradict decisions, additions, supersession, overflow, repeated queries, and status mutations; assert one unambiguous lineage-local state and target-independent return order.

PAS_MISSING_MONTE_CARLO_GATE_EXECUTABILITY: regenerate the exact pre-B0 scenario table, parameters, failure mapping, null configurations, CI bounds, infeasible-case disposition, and digest from normative files; reject any unspecified default or post-DEV table mutation.
PAS_MISSING_CLAIM_REGISTRY_CLOSURE: require every proposal, statistics, A4, LoRA, T09, and T10 claim label to resolve injectively to one canonical ID; reject orphan, duplicate, and unknown aliases.

PAS_MISSING_INFORMATION_ONTOLOGY_CLOSURE: require every serialized field and descendant metadata item to map to one canonical information class and every component-stage cell to have an explicit policy; unclassified fields fail closed.
